fusions.name: Smouldering Grip
fusions.desc: You clamp the target for 12 damage and hold it, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and setting it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Boiling Shallows
fusions.desc: You roll in a burst of steam, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and setting each [Burning] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Blood
fusions.desc: After basking for 1.5 seconds, your attack speed rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Stored Warmth
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you carry 10% fire resistance.
